Definition: properly, selected, i.e. a youth (often collective)
BiblicalUsage: Bachuwr is a young man in his prime — chosen, strong, at the height of life. Saul stood head and shoulders above the people, a choice young man; the Preacher tells the young man to rejoice in his youth and remember his Creator; Jeremiah says the young men shall fall in her streets; and Proverbs says the glory of young men is their strength. Youth, in its beauty and its danger.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that youth is a gift with a warning attached: rejoice, says the Preacher, but remember your Creator in the days of thy youth. The strength of a young man is glorious only when it is given to God.
